correctness.rationale: For each family the standardized event is first reduced to an exact one-sided tail on the stated endpoint. Gamma follows from the small-threshold exponential-integral expansion together with \(1/\Gamma(\alpha)=\alpha+O(\alpha^2)\); Pareto from the exact power tail; Weibull from its exact survival function plus Stirling and the dominance of the standard deviation over the mean; log-normal from its exact normal threshold plus Mills ratio; \(\operatorname{Beta}(1,q)\) from its exact CDF. All hypotheses and fixed-\(y\) quantifiers are explicit. A numerical script checks the exact formulas but is not used as proof.

value.rationale: The result quantifies the exact mechanisms behind five qualitative zero anti-concentration statements on the source’s own witness paths. The rates separate logarithmic, linear, essential-exponential and Gaussian-in-log-scale degeneration and diagnose non-sharp leading constants in three source bounds. This is a structural quantitative refinement useful for parameter-truncated anti-concentration estimates, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputation of a known table.
